raw_text: Chinese State Media Caught Using Old Manipur Footage in Anti-India Campaign. Indian Express investigation reveals that Chinese state media outlets CGTN and Global Times have been recycling conflict footage from May 2023 Manipur violence, mislabeling it as current events. The coordinated campaign across Chinese state outlets and pro-PRC social media accounts frames India as a failing multi-ethnic democracy. India's external affairs ministry has summoned the Chinese ambassador over the disinformation campaign.
